title: Parallel Algorithms for Group Isomorphism via Code Equivalence
summary: In this paper, we exhibit $\textsf{AC}^{3}$ isomorphism tests for coprime extensions $H \ltimes N$ where $H$ is elementary Abelian and $N$ is Abelian; and groups where $\text{Rad}(G) = Z(G)$ is elementary Abelian and $G = \text{Soc}^{*}(G)$. The fact that isomorphism testing for these families is in $\textsf{P}$ was established respectively by Qiao, Sarma, and Tang (STACS 2011), and Grochow and Qiao (CCC 2014, SIAM J. Comput. 2017).
